sources.snippet: MORES Pulse is an app that automatically detects emotions in text. It uses a sophisticated Artificial Intelligence Language Model to run the emotion detection analysis and produce visualisations. You enter any text, and MORES Pulse shows how much anger, joy, sadness, fear, disgust, and joy are present in the text and in each sentence.
